title: Запертая реальность — игровая цепочка заданий
implementation: Vanilla advancement tree and reward functions bundled as a KubeJS data pack
finale: After defeating the Ender Guardian, the player is teleported into the custom locked_reality:mage_citadel flat dimension. A datapack function builds the citadel arena and summons a tagged, custom-named, boosted Wither called the Architect. The final advancement only accepts that tagged boss.
notes: Objectives are real Minecraft advancements with inventory/entity triggers and reward functions.
Planet arrival triggers remain in place; the item objectives are not dimension-locked because inventory triggers are vanilla-global.
The campaign is an initial playable quest chain, not yet a validated 20–30 hour experience.
Later planetary resource quests require the accumulated amethyst fragments from earlier chapter rewards; the Harbinger and Ignis boss fights provide the missing fragments.
Cataclysm boss objectives are linked to Harbinger, Ignis and Ender Guardian entity defeat triggers. Their boss structures are supplied by the Cataclysm mod.
The Mage Citadel is now a custom datapack dimension with a scripted arena build function. The final boss is an enhanced, named Wither, not a new entity model or custom AI.
The Architect boss has a live boss bar updated every tick and hidden after the final victory.
